title: Provenance/Order Curvature Probe Phi_Pi and Event-Induced Endomorphisms
starting_point: V1692.1–V1692.2 derived B/S/H4 and product/O3 curvature probes. V1692.3 derives the ledger-side probe Phi_Pi and the event-induced endomorphism E_event used by rho_P^k.
claim_boundary: Mathematical derivation only. No emitter, no simulation, no retained field-law validation.

objects.Pi_p: retained provenance/order incidence ledger at comparison base
objects.d_Pi: oriented incidence/coboundary operator on retained dependency/event cochains
objects.E_event: event-induced endomorphism/action generated by A and event incidence
objects.chi_e: event incidence covector/cochain for event e

Phi_Pi.I_Pi: incidence action induced by E_C on retained dependency/order cochains
Phi_Pi.first_order_form: I_Pi(E_C; edge a→b) = <v_b - v_a, E_C u_ab> or declared incidence action of E_C on dependency generator u_ab
Phi_Pi.meaning: measures how curvature acts on retained-order/provenance incidence, not just on vector components
validity: d_Pi orientation must be declared before execution
dependency incidence signs must be retained
source labels cannot substitute for incidence action

event_induced_endomorphism.principle: Each event e induces an endomorphism E_event,e from the stationary generator A and the event's incidence projector/action.
event_induced_endomorphism.definition: E_event,e = P_e A_boundary P_e or, more generally, E_event,e = Rep_e(A_boundary, chi_e)
event_induced_endomorphism.P_e: event projector onto affected retained subspace/component
event_induced_endomorphism.Rep_e: event representation map derived from event type, incidence covector chi_e, and A action
forbidden: event projection changed after null results

rho_P_component_current.meaning: all current components are produced by applying the same Phi_k maps used for curvature to event-induced endomorphisms
rho_P_component_current.gate: rho_component_dual_action=true only if Phi_k(E_event) is emitted for every component

Pi_nulls.N_Pi_count_only: preserve dependency/event counts but drop signs/orientation; must fail Pi probe gate.
Pi_nulls.N_Pi_relabel: preserve incidence magnitudes but relabel dependency targets; should fail identity if Pi structure matters.
Pi_nulls.N_event_label_only: assign rho by event label without E_event and Phi_k; must fail rho gate.
Pi_nulls.N_event_projector_shuffle: preserve event masses but shuffle P_e across events; should fail component current alignment.
Pi_nulls.N_Eevent_fit: choose E_event to reduce residual; must fail forbidden-field gate.
